chassis.source_package: handoff_longform/ (README.md + 4 fully-resolved inline-styled HTML exports, 1440px desktop, self-contained)

grid.as_built: The exports implement the body as a 2-column CSS grid (measure + rail) inside a centred max-width container. The 88px marker gutter is a chassis rule, not a materialised grid column in these four files: no BLK-MARGIN / citation-anchor instance appears in any of the four pages, so no export needed the column. The whitespace left of the measure comes from centring the body container inside the 1440 shell (1a: 174px from shell edge to measure start; 3a/3b: 164px).
grid.recommended_build: 88px gutter | 740-762px measure | 296-300px rail, gaps 52-54px, all inside a 1160-1180px centred container with 34px page padding. Treat 740px as the canonical measure and 300px as the canonical rail.
grid.gutter_role: Not padding. Carries section markers, BLK-MARGIN notes and citation anchors that must align vertically to the paragraph they annotate.
grid.measure_rule: The measure is fixed. Body copy never reflows to the full 1440px. This is stated as the single most important thing to preserve.
grid.exhibit_break_rule_stated: Exhibits break the measure deliberately: charts and tables span gutter + measure, never the rail, so they read as evidence interrupting the argument rather than decoration beside it.
grid.exhibit_break_rule_as_built: Two mechanisms are visible: (1) exhibits placed inside the measure column run edge-to-edge of the measure with a full-bleed ink header bar (1a EXHIBIT 1/2/3, 3a EXHIBIT 1/2/3, 3b worked example); (2) genuinely measure-breaking exhibits are hoisted OUT of the body grid into their own full-container-width band (1b master exhibit and quarterly NIM table at 1092px; 3b timeline hero at 1112px). Neither mechanism ever intrudes on the rail column.
grid.scroll_behaviour: The rail is the only independently scrolling column: position:sticky; top:20px. Every other region scrolls with the page.

chassis_rules: 1a is the chassis; build it first. Everything else is furniture swaps on the same grid.
The measure is fixed and never reflows to the full 1440px.
The gutter is not padding; margin notes and citation anchors must align to the paragraph they annotate.
Exhibits span gutter + measure, never the rail.
The rail is the only independently scrolling (sticky) column.
Every figure cites a verified data-lake object; where a number is a desk computation rather than a company disclosure, the exhibit must say so.
Analysts may not hold positions in covered names.
Standing disclosure: Marsad is research and data, not investment advice. Regulated by DFSA, Marsad FZ-LLC, DIFC.
Every visual unit is an instance of a BLK-* block from the 61-block library in handoff_article_blocks/; article templates are arrangements, blocks are the vocabulary.
Suggested build order: 1a chassis, then 3b, then 1b, then 3a.
chassis_discrepancies: README states body is Newsreader 17px/1.72; no export uses that pair (1a/3a 19/1.68, 1b 17/1.66, 3b 18/1.68). Treat 17/1.72 as the token and the per-type values as the shipped overrides, or reconcile before build.
README states an 88px marker gutter column; no export materialises it, because no page contains a BLK-MARGIN or citation-anchor instance.
README states the measure is ~760px; only 3a (762px) and 3b's column (758px) match. 1a, the declared chassis, is 740px.

A 'what this is not' box is required: an explainer that teaches a mechanism must decline to recommend using it.
Evergreen — it carries a review date, not a timestamp. Re-verified every six months and re-dated when venue rules change. A stale explainer is worse than none.
Free tier by design; this is the acquisition surface, so no meter and no cut.
